description:
### Test 17 (2026-11-26)

**Bug Fixes**
- Menu cards open without a pop or flash at the end (every card)
- The top bar follows only your finger, so scrolling no longer hides and shows it by itself
- Steadier scrolling: hiding or showing the top bar no longer restyles the whole page
- No stray green glass block in SponsorBlock
- A slow swipe start no longer pops the hold line or a hidden preview part into view
